description:
*Sharbat Distribution Seva : An auspicious initiative by RCB*.

The Sharbats were freely distributed from our specially conducted Pandal at LT Road, Borivli West to literally thousands of Ganesh Bhakts forming part of the processions for immersion of Ganesh idols, as well as spectators who had lined up to catch a glimpse of the idols.

*We are glad to report that our MLA Shri Sanjay Upadhyay visited our Pandal and extended his good wishes to our Club*.

Members, their families & friends turned up in large numbers at our
specially constructed Pandal to enthusiastically serve the Sharbats.

Several of our members took to the mike to inform the crowds of RCB's flagship projects, besides exhorting the public to adhere to the Club's go green initiatives related to disposal of used cups in the designated spots to avoid littering. Members also hit the road distributing cups of Sharbats to those forming part of the core procession teams who could not break away to reach our Pandal ( such as the accompanying musicians, vehicle drivers etc).
The sharbat distribution ceremony commenced at 5 PM and ended only by 10.30 PM, by which time most of the idols and the accompanying crowds had thinned.
RCB takes great pride in reporting that the stock of sharbat on hand
was commensurate with the number of devotees seeking to quench their thirst by copiously downing the specially prepared Sharbats. In fact, by the time the processions were almost over, we had dispensed approximately 15000 cups of delicious Sharbats to an appreciative public.

Thanks too to all members & their families, the Inner Wheel team, and all volunteers for their efforts in making this Flagship Project of RCB a resounding success.

*Members would be also happy to note that an impromptu cake cutting ceremony was organized by President Aarti Parekh at the Pandal to celebrate the birthday of our member Rtn Ashwin Gala*. Needless to add, the smile on his face lit up the Pandal.

As the idols wound their way amidst the chants of “Ganapati Bappa Morya”, what remained in our collective midst was the satisfaction of having quenched the thirst of thousands. It was also the joy of true fellowship.

*This is the essence of Rotary – Serving with Heart, Leading with Purpose.*
